title: fix(console): a missing /forms/NAME renders the shared localized not-found state
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

Fixes #27446

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台 `/forms/NAME` 打开一个不存在的表单时，不再显示英文原文 "Form metadata not found: view/NAME"，改为显示控制台通用的「页面不存在」空状态（按会话语言显示，带「返回」按钮）。
- 为什么改：中文等非英文会话里这里漏出一句未翻译的英文报错，和控制台其它「找不到」页面不一致。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `FormPage.tsx` 的内部表单加载与错误渲染；仅 404 走新状态，其它加载失败照旧显示错误横幅。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` 中 `FormNotFoundError` 与 `if (notFound && !loaded)` 两处；再看测试 `FormPage.notFound-27446.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.notFound-27446.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全绿（zh 显示「页面不存在」且页面无英文）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `loadInternalForm` threw `Form metadata not found: view/NAME` for every non-OK `/meta/view/NAME` read, and `FormPage` rendered that string verbatim in its error banner, in every session language.
- A 404 from that read now throws a module-private `FormNotFoundError`. The page keeps it in its own `notFound` flag (not in the `error` string), and draws the console's shared not-found state: the `Empty` / `EmptyTitle` / `EmptyDescription` layout of the catch-all `RouteNotFound` in app-shell's `AppContent`, with its pack keys `console.notFound.title`, `console.notFound.description` and `console.notFound.back` (Go back, `navigate(-1)`). The metadata route answers 404 both for a view that does not exist and for one the caller may not read, so the page says the one thing both mean.
- Every other non-OK read keeps the error banner. Its text is now `Could not load form metadata (STATUS): view/NAME`, because after the split the old wording would claim "not found" for a 403 or a 500.
- No `@object-ui/i18n` key is added and no pack value changes (`Clause-②: no`). All ten packs already carry `console.notFound.*`.

## Tests

- New `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.notFound-27446.test.tsx`, at the real `/forms/:name` route with no provider wrapped around it:
  - zh: the state shows `页面不存在`, the zh description and a `返回` button, and the page body holds no Latin word;
  - en: `Page not found` and `Go back`, and no `Form metadata not found`;
  - CONTROL: a 500 keeps the error banner and draws no not-found state.
- Ablation: with `FormPage.tsx` restored to the merge base, all 3 cases fail (zh and en find no not-found state; CONTROL finds no `Could not load form metadata (500)` text). Restored from `HEAD`, the file's hash matched the HEAD blob.

<details><summary>Local runs (head 722dca52)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage` (all `FormPage*` suites): Test Files 39 passed (39), Tests 366 passed (366).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`: exit 0 (the console tsconfig includes `src`, so the new test is compiled).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 169 passed, 2 skipped (171).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): 0 new citations.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and the rest of the `dispatch-gates --commands` list: exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`.
- Before pushing, `ui/` was grepped for `Form metadata not found`: the only hit is the message `FormNotFoundError` keeps for logging. No test pinned the old text.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Read only, not reproduced and not filed: the public `/f/:slug` loader (`loadPublicForm`) also builds an English `Failed to load form (STATUS): ...` string that the same banner renders. It is the anonymous route and is left unchanged here.
- The other English throws in `loadInternalForm` (a form view with no `object` target, a record link naming another object) still render verbatim. They are author or link faults, not "no such form", and are out of this card's scope.

## Verification

In a zh-CN session, open `/_console/forms/no_such_form`: the page shows `页面不存在` / `你访问的链接与该应用中的任何视图都不匹配。` and a `返回` button, with no English text.
